Title: Add model path input field to installer wizard for llama.cpp backend
Description: Setup-LlamaCpp.ps1 hardcodes ModelPath='C:\Models\qwen3-coder-30b-a3b.gguf'. Users must manually edit the generated launch scripts to point at their actual GGUF file. Add a 'Model file path' input to the NetworkPage (field [5]) when llama.cpp is selected, and pass it through GetLlamaCppSetupArgs to Setup-LlamaCpp.ps1 as -ModelPath.
